dialogue.greeting: Welcome, child. The light embraces all who seek its warmth.
dialogue.curseRemoval: Through prayer and holy rites, we shall lift this darkness from you.
dialogue.hypnosisRemoval: Your mind has been clouded by dark magic. Let the light dispel it.
dialogue.purification: The corruption within you can be cleansed, one prayer at a time.
dialogue.tithe: Your generosity honors the gods. May their blessings be upon you.
dialogue.volunteer: Service to others is service to the divine. Your help is most welcome.
dialogue.farewell: Go with the light, child. May it guide your path.

dialogue.greeting: Welcome to the clinic. How can we help you today?
dialogue.stdTreatment: We can treat that infection with our modern medicines. The procedure is straightforward.
dialogue.addictionTreatment: Addiction recovery is a journey. Our detox program will help you take the first steps.
dialogue.behavioralTherapy: Behavioral patterns can be changed with proper guidance. Let's work on this together.
dialogue.neuralDeprogramming: Technological conditioning requires specialized treatment. We have the equipment for it.
dialogue.termination: This is a serious procedure. We'll ensure it's done safely and with proper care.
dialogue.checkup: A thorough examination will tell us everything we need to know.
dialogue.farewell: Take care of yourself. Come back if you need anything.

nursery.description: Professional care for pregnancy and birth

dialogue.greeting: Welcome to the nursery. We're here to help with all your maternal needs.
dialogue.eggLaying: We have comfortable facilities for egg laying. Our staff will assist you through the process.
dialogue.birth: Our midwives are experienced with all types of births. You're in good hands.
dialogue.checkup: Regular checkups are important. Let's see how everything is progressing.
dialogue.postpartum: Recovery after birth is crucial. Let us help you get back on your feet.
dialogue.consultation: Let's discuss your fertility and answer any questions you might have.
dialogue.farewell: Best of luck with your little ones. Come back anytime.
